latest_version_code.description: Android versionCode of the latest sideload APK. Must be greater than the installed versionCode to offer an update.

latest_version_name.description: User-facing version name shown in the update sheet.

apk_url.description: HTTPS URL of the latest APK (Firebase Storage or any HTTPS host). Leave empty until an APK is uploaded.

defaultValue.value: Owner unlink disables shared copies (Remove only). Language on login. Settings language stays on Settings. PalGate unlink per system. Pending invites on Gates. Light theme default, darker cabin contrast. BT-off inside opens via native pollNearby.

release_notes.description: Optional what's-new text for the in-app update sheet.
